storylines.title: Ochai Agbaji, Thunder Agree To Contract
storylines.summary: Ochai Agbaji has agreed to sign with the Oklahoma City Thunder. The Thunder had an open roster spot and a major need on the wing following injuries to Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace last Sunday. Agbaji was waived by the New York Knicks at the end of preseason. In 62 games last season with the Toronto Raptors and Brooklyn Nets, Agbaji averaged 5.1 points and 2.3 rebounds in 15.7 minutes. Agbaji was the 14th overall pick in the 2022 NBA draft by the Utah Jazz.

storylines.title: Mike Brown On Struggling Knicks: 'We Have To Hit Singles'
storylines.summary: New York Knicks head coach Mike Brown said that his team has to return to playing simple after a 98-93 loss to the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday night. They are now 2-4 on the season. "We're trying to get a home run every time we get the ball," Brown said. "We have to hit singles." The Knicks shot just 40.7% from the field and 31.7% from three. Jalen Brunson added that the Knicks need to be more decisive in their play. "Sometimes it can be us being hesitant as well, wanting to make the right play," said Brunson. "We understand what we have to do, it's just starting the game that way. That has to be our biggest point of emphasis going forward." Mikel Bridges continued his early season struggles, finishing with 12 points and five rebounds. Bridges is averaging 6.2 points and 2.8 rebounds on the year. Karl-Anthony Towns echoed Brunson in saying that the team needs to improve how they start games. "I think we did a great job in the fourth quarter of finding that gear, of getting out the quicksand, finally turning gears into motion. "It puts us in position where you've got to make some magic happen, and we just didn't have enough magic today to get back and win the game," said Towns.

storylines.title: LeBron James, Joel Embiid Out Saturday Due To Injury Management
storylines.summary: LeBron James and Joel Embiid will miss the Philadelphia 76ers' matchup against the Charlotte Hornets on Saturday due to injury management. James will miss the game due to low back/sciatica, with Embiid out with right foot plantar fasciitis. The Hornets game is a back-to-back for the Sixers, with the team expected to be cautious with James and Embiid throughout the season. James finished with what Nick Nurse called his " best game " for the Sixers on Friday night against the Knicks.
